## Key Honors & Distinctions
- **1st Place Winner — AI Seekho Day 2026 Gemma Fine-Tuning Hackathon**: Outperformed competitive teams by fine-tuning Google Gemma 4 12B with 4-bit NF4 QLoRA on a 18k sample instruction dataset, achieving 94.40% verification accuracy with production inference optimizations.

## Featured Technical Projects
- **Gemma Claim Verification Engine**: Autonomous fact-checking and claim verification engine fine-tuned from Google Gemma 4 12B using 4-bit NF4 QLoRA, sub-50ms token latency, and hallucination reduction heuristics.
- **Personal AI Employee**: Local-first autonomous executive assistant agent running on custom tool orchestration with local LLMs and persistent task queues.
- **AutoGrader Agent**: Autonomous multi-agent code grading system evaluating AST correctness, security patterns, and style rubrics.
- **SHAP Agentic IDS**: Explainable AI network intrusion detection combining gradient boosting with SHAP-driven alert reasoning and automated defensive actions.
- **InboxVerity AI**: Multi-layered email security agent detecting spear phishing, spoofing, and social engineering attacks via LLM threat signals.
- **CareerPilot Agent**: Career trajectory planning agent performing semantic skill matching against live tech industry job listings.
- **Agentic Fire & Hazard Detection**: Vision-based safety detection pipeline integrating YOLO and agentic incident escalation protocols.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Autonomous Agents**: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, ReAct pattern, Tool Calling, Vector Stores, Multi-Agent Swarms.
- **Large Language Models**: Google Gemma, Llama 3, Mistral, HuggingFace Transformers, PEFT, LoRA/QLoRA, Unsloth, Ollama, vLLM, Prompt Engineering.
- **Machine Learning & Deep Learning**: PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, SHAP, OpenCV, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy, Data Pipelines.
